subject: Preserve dead-admissible queued commands through lethal cleanup
description: On baseline `2338dc115`, old schema-12 representative `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_linux2/Profile_002/Continue/replay-004-session-0001.jsonl.zst` panicked on RNG cardinality after frame 8319. Soldier150's lethal sword hit on PC137 entered Rust death cleanup while Soldier153's simultaneous `ReceiveSwordDamage` card was still `Todo`; `kill_owner_sequences` interrupted that card, so Rust omitted its two `SwordDamageProtection` draws and later `MeleeProvoke` draw. Original sequence Hourglass consumes the live FIFO until empty (`original-code/RHsequencemanager.cpp:938-951`), Human/PC `Kill` does not purge owner sequences (`original-code/RHelementactorhuman.cpp:9229-9235`; `original-code/RHelementactorpc.cpp:2213-2248`), and dead `RHElementActorHuman::Instruct` still admits queued ReceiveHitDamage, ReceiveSwordDamage, ReceiveArrowDamage, ReceiveDamage, ReceiveMobileDamage, Wait, and GetKilledAtBottom while rejecting ReceiveNet and all other commands (`original-code/RHelementactorhuman.cpp:2989-3026`). Commit `9e7c4fb0f` preserves exactly that seven-command `Todo` whitelist through Rust's otherwise necessary hard death cleanup, while continuing to interrupt active, postponed, and unrelated queued owner work. The direct manager table covers all seven admitted commands plus rejected ReceiveStoneDamage and WaitTimer; the simultaneous-hit regression proves the second damage leaves `Todo`, executes, and consumes the exact protection/provoke RNG triplet while unrelated work is interrupted. `cargo test -p robin_engine --lib` passes all 3,032 tests and scoped diff checks pass. The optimized representative clears the frame-8319 RNG panic and advances to a new lifecycle frontier after frame 8320 on PC137: Original retains animation 105 (`DyingSword`) with command `ReceiveSwordDamage`, while Rust exposes animation 283 with command `Wait`. No displayed-field workaround was applied. Independent schema-14 control `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x-schema14/traces/Savegame_Cyrdach/Profile_156/Savegame_001/replay-009-session-0001.jsonl.zst` matches exact EOF on the same runner.
